description: If \(\operatorname{unify}(P)\) returns \(\mu\), every unifier \(\sigma:\mathbb N\to\operatorname{Term}_L(A)\) factors as \(\mu(x)[\rho]=\sigma(x)\) for all variables, for any target alphabet \(A\).
signature:
